description: Turns automatic credit reload on/off. Needs canCharge; the reload amount may not exceed the key max single charge, and every reload counts in this key monthly card-charge cap and in the account budget limit. Turning it on (or changing it while on) takes two steps: without confirmationToken returns the settings and a token; call again with the same arguments and the token once the user approved. Turning it off applies at once. Threshold $10-$5,000, amount $50-$10,000 (turning it off may repeat the amount already saved, as gpucloud_get_auto_reload returns it). monthlyCapCad: the most the automatic reloads may charge per calendar month (Montreal time), $50-$100,000, null = no cap, absent = unchanged (200 for a new configuration); once reached, no automatic reload until next month and the user is told. It never limits a manual payment. [SPENDS MONEY] (permission: billing:auto_reload) [Requires a free GPU Cloud account and MCP key]

confirmationToken.description: Token returned by the previous call (valid 10 minutes, single use).

name: gpucloud_set_auto_reload
title: Change auto-reload
